beats.say: This diode is designed to be used backwards.
A Zener diode looks like a normal diode, but its bar has little bent ends.
Connected in reverse, it holds the voltage across it steady, here at five point one volts, even when the supply changes.
That fixed voltage is called the Zener voltage, and you can buy them in lots of different values.
Next time: the op-amp. Subscribe so you don't miss it.

youtube.learn: How a Zener diode holds a steady voltage in reverse, its symbol, and how it makes a simple voltage regulator.
